description: Scenario IDs whose PARTIAL status is expected on loopback svnserve CI and must not fail the Build & Test gate when they are the only non-PASS rows.

rationale.R16_SVNSERVE_GIT_REMOTE_UNREACHABLE: Loopback fixture proves transport failure blocking and unchanged checkpoint; full R16 remote-recreation catalog remains open (remote_transport_failed).
rationale.R16_SVNSERVE_SVN_REMOTE_UNREACHABLE: Loopback svnserve cannot recreate remotes after failure; transport blocking and checkpoint isolation are still exercised.
